content: We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is implicit; we need to get data via NMR or IR. Carbonyl groups show up in IR ~1700 cm-1. Could use IR spectra tool to detect carbonyl. Also carbonyl carbon appears in 13C NMR around 190-220 ppm. Use carbon NMR. Since we just need count, easiest is IR detection of C=O peaks. Use ir_spectra tool.
